description: This Java class implements the <call-service-asynch> element of a mini-language, providing functionality to asynchronously invoke a service with specified parameters within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CallServiceAsynch
classes.description: Final class implementing the asynchronous service invocation logic specified by the <call-service-asynch> element, including handling of parameters, user login context, and error reporting.

methods.name: CallServiceAsynch
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by parsing the XML element and extracting configuration attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the asynchronous service call by preparing parameters and invoking the dispatcher; handles exceptions and updates method context accordingly.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Adds the service name to the artifact info context for documentation or analysis purposes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, describing the configured call.
